picks.name: nthng
picks.source_note: New artist discovery, debut on topo2. Similar ambient/dub-techno territory to your Bitchin Bajas and Le Motel picks.
picks.bio: "Last Light of the Sun" (October 2, 2026, topo2) is nthng's fifth album and debut on the label -- a ten-track double LP moving fluidly between ambient, techno, dub, dream pop and drum & bass.
picks.why_listen: A genre-roaming, richly textured record -- useful for a broad set, from atmospheric intros through to driving dub-techno stretches.

picks.name: Mergui
picks.bio: "Spotlight" (October 2, 2026) is a slinky nu-disco single ahead of Mergui's upcoming "Gut Feeling" EP -- silky vocals over seventies-flavoured, elegant dancefloor-geared production, co-written with Jesse Shatkin and Alvaro Rodriguez.
picks.why_listen: Light, elegant nu-disco with real dancefloor intent -- a smooth, vocal-forward change of pace for a set.
